column1: # The frozen clause scope of the ECMA-262 census: one root clause id per line.
# Ruling R-P1 makes the section scope authored data rather than code, so that a
# scope change is a data review. Each id must occur exactly once as an
# `<emu-clause id=...>` in vendor/ecma262-0248456c/spec.html; every census row
# must lie inside one of the windows; a listed root that governs no row, and a
# row outside every window, both fail generation.
